strings.BOXXY accounts are optional. You can con: BOXXY accounts are optional. You can play without one; local progress stays in your browser on your device.
strings.If you create an account with a BOXXY pa: If you make an account with a BOXXY secret code, BOXXY stores your handle, email, one-way secret code hash, account dates, signup + latest IP, latest browser/device user-agent, signed-in active time, and the progress/vibe settings needed for cloud brains. Your actual secret code is never stored in readable form.
strings.You may instead use Sign in with Google,: You can use Google sign-in instead, or link Google to an existing BOXXY account. BOXXY stores Google’s stable account ID + verified email so it maps back to the same BOXXY user. Google-only accounts don’t have BOXXY secret code login. BOXXY never gets your Google secret code; Google handles authentication under its own privacy terms.
strings.Account information, linked authenticati: Account info, linked sign-in info + cloud progress live in Cloudflare D1 and are used to run the account, sync progress, administer BOXXY and prevent abuse. A strictly necessary secure session cookie is used while signed in. Account emails are not used for ads; they may be used when reasonably needed for account, security, abuse or support. Yeet your account from the account screen to yeet the cloud account + cloud progress; local browser progress stays.
strings.On a browser’s first visit, BOXXY uses t: On a browser’s first visit, BOXXY uses Cloudflare’s spawn country code for the request to pick the default display language. That first-visit spawn country is kept in the browser + a strictly necessary cookie; no anonymous database aura check is made. If you later lock in, the first spawn country + chosen language are lock it ind with your BOXXY account so the setting follows you across devices and admins can see it in Basement.
strings.From v376, signed-in players have indivi: Since v376, locked-in homies have per-brainrot attempt lore. Since v377, a run only starts when a valid move starts/resumes the clock. Records include brainrot, start/end times + completion status; unfinished runs can also record time, moves + pushes. Unfinished runs never count for PBs or public aura boards. Offline attempts queue locally. Players can review their lore in account vibe settings; admins can see it in Basement. Older lock it ind PBs/totals show where ready to send, but missing individual runs can’t be reconstructed. Yeet the account and its cloud attempt lore goes too.
strings.BOXXY uses PostHog, hosted in the Europe: BOXXY uses EU-hosted PostHog to measure visits + a small set of gameplay events: open game, choose pack, start/run it back quest, clear quest, hit next. Events can include pack, quest, moves, pushes, time, guided-solve use, screen orientation + a simple new/returning label. That label only checks whether this browser already had BOXXY’s local device marker when the page opened; the marker itself is not sent to PostHog.
strings.PostHog is configured in cookieless mode: PostHog runs cookieless. It doesn’t store BOXXY analytics IDs in cookies/local/session storage, and BOXXY does not send account handles or emails to PostHog. URL query strings + fragments are stripped before analytics events go out.
strings.PostHog receives the ordinary technical: PostHog gets the normal technical info needed to deliver + measure a web request, like browser/device info, page path + referrer. BOXXY asks PostHog to respect supported Do Not Track signals. Read

strings.BOXXY is provided “as is”. Although care: BOXXY is provided “as is”. Care goes into it, but there’s no promise it will always be bug-free, uninterrupted, work on every device or exist forever.
